review_scope: Exactly the three frozen model-generated feasibility candidates in the input packet; retain all three in the denominator. This is not a confirmatory inferential cohort and does not authorize scoring.
display_procedure: Before review, a custodian independent of claim generation and scoring verifies every row against the frozen cohort and private source-lineage manifest and verifies the staged media bytes. The custodian assigns a random per-review token and stores each verified video copy as <token>.mp4 with mode 0600; a separate private custody manifest binds each token to the worksheet row and source/staged media hashes. The reviewer receives only the HTML page and opaque media directory, not the worksheet, custody manifest, dataset IDs/indexes, source paths, gold answers, QA seed intervals, or outcome scores. The page displays the random token and expected filename for each card and checks that the selected file name matches that random token; it contains only a per-review salted media-check digest needed to bind the selected bytes, not a stable media hash or stable dataset-derived identifier. After review, a custodian independently rehashes the staged media and validates the token crosswalk before accepting the review record. The reviewer watches the full video at normal speed with audio muted and text/caption tracks disabled. Burned-in subtitles, captions, or other overlaid text may remain visible; reviewers must not use text overlays as support, and a claim supported only by them fails.
permitted_evidence: Visible source-video pixels only; audio, subtitles, captions, metadata, QA gold answer, QA seed intervals, and model outcome scores are not evidence and remain hidden during mapping.
support_rule: A claim is supported only if every material factual component is visibly established by one or more localizable video moments. Partial, contradicted, unsupported, ambiguous, or unlocalizable claims fail the frozen full-cohort review gate; do not invent or borrow intervals.
interval_rule: Record every distinct visually sufficient occurrence as a separate positive-duration interval in source-video player seconds, with inclusive endpoints rounded to the nearest millisecond. Do not merge disjoint occurrences or select a subset. After mapping is frozen, the claim-linked mask is the union of sampled frames overlapping any listed interval. Decoder PTS calibration and any disjoint-control selection are separate protocol gates and are not established by this review.
failure_rule: Any item without a fully supported claim, verified source identity, complete review, at least one valid interval, or a valid equal-count disjoint temporal control is recorded as a failure; retain the frozen denominator and do not substitute or silently exclude items.
review_order: Freeze this policy and exact claim-input/cohort manifests before viewing any item. A custodian validates source lineage and exact bytes, creates token-named mode-0600 copies and a private token-to-row custody manifest, and separately records the manifest digest before the reviewer receives materials. A human reviewer independent of claim generation, scoring, and custody reviews all three items without the worksheet, custody manifest, dataset indexes, gold answers, QA seed intervals, or outcomes, and does not consult public dataset indexes, answer sites, or external searches during review; the reviewer attests to independence from generation, scoring, and custody and to not viewing the custody crosswalk. The reviewer exports only random tokens and judgments/intervals. Freeze and hash that export before any QA-seed comparison or score access. A separate custodian then verifies complete token coverage, staged-media hashes, source mapping, and review export. Human attestation remains required.
